name: Dashboard
creator: NanoKVM Team
desc: Read-only dashboard for the device and its target host, on screen and in the browser.

DASHBOARD_WEB_PORT.label: Web port
DASHBOARD_WEB_PORT.description: HTTP port for the status page, served only while the App is open.

DASHBOARD_PROBE_HOST.label: Internet probe IP
DASHBOARD_PROBE_HOST.description: IP address checked with a TCP connection to port 443. IP only, so the check does not depend on DNS.

DASHBOARD_DNS_NAME.label: DNS probe name
DASHBOARD_DNS_NAME.description: Host name resolved to check DNS.
